info.title: Krun API
info.description: Krun decision API (closed beta). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer krun_live_...`.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and serving HTTP.

Readiness: configuration was valid at startup (the server refuses to start otherwise) and PostgreSQL answers.
RunPod is deliberately not probed (it scales to zero; probing would cost money and cold starts).

post.summary: Upload a media file for use in decision contexts.
post.description: The request body is the file; `Content-Type` is its MIME type (checked against the content).

415.description: UNSUPPORTED_MIME_TYPE (type not supported, or the content does not match it).

200.description: One answer per question, typed like its question (`choice`, `noul`, `score`). Request id in the `X-Request-ID` header.

error.message: questions.department: 1 options given; between 2 and 64 are required

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no decision with this request_id in this project

Answer.description: An answer, discriminated by `type` (same type as its question).

Asset.description: An uploaded media file, usable only by the project that uploaded it.

id.description: Id of an asset uploaded with `POST /v1/assets` by the same project.

expires_at.description: After this time the asset can no longer be referenced (default 24 h after upload).

AudioPart.description: WAV / MP3 / FLAC / OGG, max 10 MB and 30 s (20 s recommended: longer speech may be transcribed only partially); 1 per request.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id of the part (echoed only in errors).

asset_id.description: Id of an asset uploaded with `POST /v1/assets` by the same project.

choice.description: Selected option id, or `null` when the model abstains (the best guess is still visible in `probabilities`).

confidence.description: Abstention score (KRUN-005): top-1 minus top-2 calibrated probability, in [0, 1].

probabilities.description: Calibrated probability per option id, in request order.

abstain.description: True when `confidence` is below the abstention threshold.

abstention_status.description:
`calibrated` only for intent questions with label-only options; `advisory` otherwise (tool routing, intents
with descriptions): abstention is then a hint, not a validated guarantee.

ChoiceQuestion.description: Pick one of the given options.

options.description:
Option id → description (2–64 options). Ids are returned as-is in `choice` and `probabilities`. Use `""`
(or `null`) for label-only options.

oneOf.description:
`intent` (default) or `tool` (tool/function routing). Selects the model's instructions and the abstention
status: tool routing is always `advisory`.

context.description: The text to decide on (1–8,000 characters), or an ordered list of 1–16 content parts; text parts are joined with newlines. Media parts (image, document, audio) reference uploaded assets. Every modality is input only: the answer is always the structured decision. Video is not supported.

questions.description:
Question id → question (1–16). Question ids (1–100 characters) are returned as keys of `answers`. Questions of
different types can be mixed in one request.

model.description: Optional model id (see `GET /v1/models`); defaults to the current model.

DecideResponse.description: Decision response. The request id is returned in the `X-Request-ID` header.

answers.description: Question id → answer, in request order.

DocumentPart.description: PDF / DOCX / plain text / Markdown / HTML (max 25 MB, 20 pages), or a page image; up to 2 per request. Documents with a text layer are read as text; scans go through OCR + vision.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id of the part (echoed only in errors).

asset_id.description: Id of an asset uploaded with `POST /v1/assets` by the same project.

oneOf.description: The option id that should have been chosen (1–200 characters).

value.description: The option id that should have been chosen (1–200 characters).

oneOf.description: The correct level index (0 = first level).

value.description: The correct level index (0 = first level).

ExpectedAnswer.description: The answer that should have been given, typed like the question (KRUN-011).

request_id.description: `X-Request-ID` of a `/v1/decide` call made by the same project.

question_id.description:
Key of the answer being reviewed (the question id from the request). Always required, also for single-question
requests, so every feedback row names exactly one answer.

oneOf.description:
The correct answer, typed like the question: `{"type": "choice", "value": "billing"}`,
`{"type": "noul", "value": true}` or `{"type": "score", "value": 2}`.

expected_decision.description:
Choice only, kept for compatibility: the option id that should have been chosen (≤ 200 characters). Same as
`expected: {"type": "choice", "value": ...}`; if both are sent they must agree.

metadata.description: Optional JSON object (≤ 8 KiB serialized). Do not put personal data here.

ImagePart.description: PNG / JPEG / WebP, max 10 MB; up to 4 images per request.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id of the part (echoed only in errors).

asset_id.description: Id of an asset uploaded with `POST /v1/assets` by the same project.

MultiAnswer.description: Answer to a `multi` question (Krun One V1).

values.description: Option ids that apply, in request order (possibly empty).

probabilities.description: Probability that each option applies (independent, not a distribution), in request order.

MultiQuestion.description: Select every option that applies (Krun One V1): each option gets its own probability.

options.description: Option id → description (2–64 options). Use `""` (or `null`) for label-only options.

instructions.description: Optional instruction (1–1,000 characters), e.g. "Select every element present in the document".

noul.description: Probability that the proposition holds, in [0, 1] (0 = clearly false, 0.5 = uncertain, 1 = clearly true).

NoulCriteria.description: Optional texts describing when a `noul` proposition is true / false (either may be omitted).

true.description: What makes the proposition true (1–500 characters).

false.description: What makes the proposition false (1–500 characters).

NoulQuestion.description: Probability that a yes/no proposition about the context holds.

instructions.description:
The proposition, phrased as a yes/no question (1–1,000 characters), e.g. "Is the customer asking to speak
with a human?".

oneOf.description: Optional description of what counts as true / false.

score.description: Expected level Σ index × probability, in [0, levels − 1] (not the most likely level).

confidence.description:
Concentration of the distribution, in [0, 1]: 1 − variance / maximum variance of the level index. 1 = all
probability on one level; 0 = split between the lowest and the highest level.

legend.description: Level index ("0", "1", ...) → the level text from the request.

probabilities.description: Level index → calibrated probability, in level order.

ScoreQuestion.description: Rate the context on ORDERED levels. Level order is semantic: index 0 is the lowest level.

instructions.description: What to rate (1–1,000 characters), e.g. "How severe is the reported issue?".

levels.description:
2–16 level descriptions, lowest first (1–500 characters each). Prefer descriptive levels
("Blocking issue; no workaround") over bare numbers.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id of the part (echoed only in errors).

input_tokens.description:
Input tokens processed by the model (Krun One tokenizer, summed over the questions — each question is scored
as its own sequence). `null` only if the backend did not report it.
